answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by tying every identity to a thread of verifiable work that no cheap copy can fake. At dawn each new agent stakes a small bond and solves a unique-work puzzle seeded by its hardware attestation, so a thousand clones cost a thousand real machines. Peers co-sign the outcome, and a rotating beacon publishes the registry root hourly; any identity the beacon does not list is ignored until its bond is genuinely re-earned.
